name: Prepare and run candidate searches
summary: Gather terms, optionally generate five, then run bounded searches and return separate attributable attempts.

steps.label: Choose the search approach
steps.human: Choose one or more compatible offered keyword/vector search contracts for the original question, within the main plan and remaining budget. Select useful known component filters. This is not an instruction to run all methods or to execute them concurrently. Unsupported vector readiness excludes that method.
consumes: Original question, trusted context, offered contracts and compatible strategy advice
produces: Selected search contracts and required inputs

steps.label: Gather supplied or known terms
steps.human: Collect useful caller keywords and terms in permitted context. Retain their origin and pass them to the separate sufficiency decision; do not generate terms or broaden scope. Prepare each selected contract separately. Reuse terms only where that contract accepts their meaning and scope; preserve their binding to query/version/source.
consumes: Selected search contracts and required inputs
produces: Known terms grouped by selected contract

steps.label: Decide whether terms suffice
steps.human: Choose known-term bypass or optional generation from the selected input contract. Do not author search terms. Judge each selected contract independently; accepting terms for one does not bind them to every method.
consumes: Known terms grouped by selected contract

steps.label: Request optional term generation
steps.human: Only after the generation decision, construct the proposed typed request and persist kernel host handoff. Bind original question, approved context and selected query/version/source. Otherwise route directly to search. Each request is bound to its own contract/query/version/source. Compatible term reuse remains explicit and validated, not a global unbound input set.
produces: Typed per-contract requests or known-term bypasses

steps.label: Optionally generate five terms
steps.human: Generate exactly five distinct nonempty search suggestions. The model is interchangeable. Terms are not facts. This proposed operation uses existing typed host transport. This optional action repeats only for the selected contracts that need generation, within the same cumulative budget.

steps.label: Validate term output
steps.human: Validate matching resume and exactly five distinct nonempty terms. Invalid results follow bounded correction or an explicit limitation without searching.

steps.label: Judge term usefulness
steps.human: Choose accept, correction, clarification or stop against the original question. Known-term bypass skips these generation-only actions.

steps.label: Run separate retrieval attempts
steps.human: Execute the permitted bounded searches once. Keep each attempt separate: original question, method/query/version, terms, component filters, source/revision, model/version where relevant, budget, evidence locators, coverage and outcome. Do not combine candidates yet. Empty evidence, denied access, outage, missing mapping and partial coverage remain distinct. Structurally valid but semantically rejected terms do not execute. Preserve the main attempt history and cumulative budget; selecting multiple searches does not imply parallel execution. Return useful evidence even if another attempt fails. Use only the inputs validated and accepted for that specific method/query contract.
consumes: Per-contract Jev-accepted terms or explicit sufficient-known/no-term bypass

steps.label: Return separate search outcomes
steps.human: Return each method/query attempt with its original question, terms, filters, source/version, evidence and limitations. Keep empty, partial, denied, unsupported and failed outcomes distinct. Do not compare or combine here; join [the shared comparison](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#compare) once.

branches.label: Useful terms already available — skip LLM
branches.condition: Known terms suffice for the selected contract, or the method needs no terms
branches.human: From term collection, bypass optional generation and proceed directly to search with validated known terms. A method needing no terms also bypasses generation.

branches.label: An attempt was unhelpful
branches.condition: One selected search is empty, incomplete or fails
branches.human: Return the explicit outcome to [shared comparison](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#compare). Jev may choose a different permitted method or traversal; do not erase useful prior evidence or repeat the unchanged failed plan.

provenance.note:
Target design — not a delivery claim
User-requested question-first design. This flow is spec/draft; existing runtime and test evidence do not establish this full contract. Existing acceptance criteria are context pending behavioral mapping, not new completion proof.

Traversal and multiple-method design extension
Added bounded method selection/return routes and a shared attempt-comparison handoff. Target specification only; no runtime or acceptance-status change.
